Location: Toronto, ON (in office) · Markets: Canada and US · Full\-time


Reports to: COO and CEO

 **About Snaplii**


Snaplii is a profitable, fast\-growing fintech company building the next generation of payments and AI\-powered financial solutions across North America.

 **Our traction:**

* 400K\+ users and approximately CAD $200M (US$150M) in annual payment volume.
* 3x year\-over\-year company growth, with profitable operations.
* 500\+ brand partners, including Walmart and Uber.
* AI\-powered payments live on Muse, with 2,000\+ AI agents connected to Snaplii's payment infrastructure.

 **The role**


We are seeking a VP of Growth to own the growth of the Snaplii app in Canada and the US, including monthly active users (MAU) and transaction volume.


We are looking for a traffic\-driven growth leader who can bring in new users and keep them coming back to buy.


This is a hands\-on role: you set the strategy and run it yourself.

 **Key responsibilities**

* Own the app's growth: MAU, transaction volume, new purchasing users and repeat purchases.
* Grow new users at an efficient cost (CAC) with a fast payback.
* Drive repeat purchases through lifecycle marketing, cashback offers and promotions.
* Build traffic across paid ads, social media, communities, creators and partnerships.
* Lead referral and product\-led growth with the product team.
* Lead community building and PR, including Chinese\-language media.
* Manage the marketing budget, track results, and report to the COO and CEO.

 **Qualifications**

**Required (in order of priority):**

* 5\+ years in consumer growth or marketing for an app or e\-commerce business.
* Has owned growth results and can share past MAU, transaction volume, CAC, retention and payback numbers.
* Strong in at least two of: product\-led growth, partnerships, PR, social media/community.
* Strong logic and data skills: can calculate CAC, LTV and payback on your own.
* Hands\-on: runs campaigns yourself, not only through agencies or a team.
* Hardworking, accountable for results, honest about failures, and careful with spending.
* Fluent in English and Mandarin (needed for our Chinese\-language community and media work).

 **Preferred:**

* Strong with AI tools for creative, campaigns and analysis.
* Experience in both the Canadian and US markets.

 **Compensation**

* Base salary: CAD $200,000 per year
* Performance bonus: up to CAD $100,000 per year, based on quarterly growth targets (MAU, transaction volume and new purchasing users)

  

Based in our Toronto office. Our team works in both English and Mandarin.

jobs.description:
This position is accountable for leading global risk transformation and execution initiatives for Global Operations Risk and Controls, with primary responsibility for the Risk and Control Self\-Assessment (RCSA) program across Line 1\. The role will translate strategy into practical execution plans, coordinate delivery across businesses and functions, and provide senior leaders with clear visibility into progress, quality, risk, and outcomes.

  

  

The role combines enterprise program leadership, data analytics, executive reporting, and identification of AI and automation opportunities. The successful candidate will work directly with complex and imperfect data, conduct targeted quality reviews, challenge scope and assumptions, identify trends and themes, and translate findings into practical recommendations. As priorities evolve, the role will apply these capabilities to other Operations Risk and Control Transformation initiatives.

  

  

This is a highly visible individual\-contributor role requiring strong judgment, analytical capability, and the ability to lead across a complex global organization through influence rather than formal authority.

  

  

**Position Responsibilities:**

Lead global risk transformation and execution


* Own integrated plans, milestones, governance, and escalation for global risk transformation initiatives, with RCSA as the initial priority.
* Drive delivery across businesses and functions, challenging scope, capacity, sequencing, and other risks to committed outcomes.
* Build alignment and accountability across ELT areas, L1B teams, Process Owners, Line 2, Technology, and delivery partners through influence rather than formal authority.
  

  

Generate actionable insights


* Analyze risk, control, execution, and remediation data to identify trends, gaps, emerging risks, and management actions.
* Conduct targeted business analysis and sample quality reviews, including assessments of scope, exceptions, control effectiveness, and supporting evidence.
* Translate findings into clear requirements, practical recommendations, and targeted feedback for accountable teams.
  

  

Enable senior leadership decisions


* Deliver concise ELT and ERC reporting on execution, delivery confidence, control effectiveness, quality, and emerging risks.
* Create clear executive narratives that explain what is progressing well, what requires attention, why it matters, and what action is needed.
* Present credible options and recommendations where leadership decisions on scope, timing, capacity, prioritization, or investment are required.
  

  

Advance AI, automation, and process improvement


* Effectively use AI tools to improve manual processes, deepen insights, and drive efficiency.
* Identify high\-value opportunities for automation, analytics, and process redesign.
* Define and prioritize practical use cases, then engage the broader team and delivery partners to design and implement solutions.

Support adoption and measure whether new capabilities improve execution speed, quality, consistency, and risk outcomes.  
* 

**Qualifications:**


* Significant experience in operational risk, controls, transformation, program management, data analytics, or a related financial\-services discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting RCSA execution, control assessment and testing, or a comparable enterprise risk program is required.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional programs across multiple businesses, functions, or geographies.
* Strong analytical capability, including experience working with large or imperfect data sets, reconciling inconsistencies, identifying trends, and translating findings into practical recommendations.
* Experience preparing senior executive materials, management reporting, and recommendations for governance forums.
* Experience identifying or delivering AI, automation, analytics, or process\-improvement opportunities is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, risk, engineering, data/analytics, or a related discipline; a relevant graduate degree or professional risk/control certification is an asset.
  

  

**Competencies:**


* Enterprise program leadership: translates strategy into practical execution plans and maintains momentum across complex global initiatives.
* Analytical problem solving: moves comfortably between executive issues and the underlying process, data, and control detail.
* Risk and business judgment: balances methodology, execution practicality, risk, investment, and business impact.
* Data curiosity and discipline: challenges numbers, reconciles inconsistencies, tests assumptions, and communicates data limitations clearly.
* Executive communication: turns complex program, data, and risk information into concise, decision\-useful messages.
* Influence without authority: drives accountability and action across senior stakeholders without formal reporting relationships.
* Technology and innovation mindset: identifies realistic applications of AI, automation, and analytics and connects them to business outcomes.
* Comfort with ambiguity: makes progress when requirements, data, priorities, or operating models are evolving.
* Continuous improvement mindset: simplifies work, strengthens quality, and builds scalable approaches that can be reused across risk programs.
  

  

***When you join our team:***


* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well\-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

**About Innerlogic**

Most organizations survey their people, then wait months for the analysis. By the time the report lands, the moment to act has often passed. Innerlogic closes that gap.

We’re an employee listening platform with an agentic twist. Teams run engagement, pulse and 360 surveys on Innerlogic, and Nora, our AI analyst, turns the results into reports, insights and action plans in minutes. Qualtrics and Culture Amp were built for a world where analysis took a team and a quarter. We’re building for one where it takes an afternoon.

* **Own the brand and website.** Steward the brand and run the website as a conversion engine, working with product on design.
* **Run marketing operations.** Own the CRM and marketing automation setup, lead scoring, attribution and reporting, so we always know what’s working.

**Your first 90 days**

* Learn the product, our customers, and the deals we’ve won and lost. Talk to customers and consultancy partners.
* Deliver a positioning refresh and a 12\-month marketing plan with targets and budget.
* Launch the first repeatable pipeline program, and the reporting to measure it.

**What you bring**

* 7\+ years in B2B marketing, ideally SaaS, including at least 2 years owning demand generation or the whole marketing function at an early\-stage company.
* A track record of building pipeline from little or nothing, with the numbers to show for it.
* Excellent writing. You can produce a sharp landing page, email or one\-pager yourself.
* Product marketing instincts: you can turn a technical product into a clear story for a specific buyer.
* Comfort with data and modern tools. You run your own CRM, automation and analytics, build your own dashboards and make budget calls from them.
* You already work AI\-first. You use tools like Claude to research, write, analyze and automate, and you can walk us through a workflow you built that changed your output.
* Range. You’re happy moving from strategy to a campaign launch to fixing a form in the same day.

**Nice to have**

* Experience marketing to HR, People or employee experience buyers.
* Partner or channel marketing experience.
* HubSpot experience.
* Experience marketing an AI product.

**What we offer**

* $115,000–$135,000 CAD base salary, plus a meaningful stock option grant vesting over time.
* A real budget for programs, tools and contractors.
* Direct influence on company strategy, working alongside the founders.
* Hybrid work from our new Bedford office.
* A clear path to VP Marketing as the team grows.

**How we hire**

A short intro call, conversations with our founders and the team, and a small practical exercise. We’ll walk you through the details on the first call.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume and a short note on a pipeline program you built: what you did and what it produced. Links to work you wrote or launched are welcome. We review applications as they arrive and aim to have someone in the role by early 2027\.

Innerlogic welcomes applicants of all backgrounds. If you need an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, tell us and we’ll work with you.

Pay: $115,000\.00\-$135,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bedford, NS B4A 4J4
